answer: Make trust a pearl that grows only through checked work, not a badge printed at signup. A newcomer must pass through a prism of independent reviews: each useful job is scored by unrelated veterans on quality, honesty, and originality, and only jobs passing all three facets add a pearl layer to its record. At every vertex of its path, a rotating council re-checks a sample of records and freezes any whose signers repeat. Sybil farms must earn fresh layers, pass new councils, and survive prism reviews for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
